Wrong Products, Denied Returns, Poor Support. I had a very disappointing experience with Myntra customer support. They were unable to properly investigate or resolve my issue. I have faced problems with two different orders from the seller Livewear, where the wrong products were delivered. Despite this, my return requests were denied without a proper investigation. Because of this, Myntra is making me bear a loss of nearly ₹6,000 for products that were not what I ordered. As a customer, I expected Myntra to trace the issue, verify the deliveries, and provide a fair resolution instead of simply rejecting the returns. Myntra should improve its customer support and ensure sellers are held accountable when they ship incorrect products.

Anonymous. This is by far one of the worst shopping experiences I have ever had. The app is completely unprofessional, customer service is useless, and the overall quality is extremely poor. They misguided me about the delivery timeline, and due to my visa delay, I was unable to check the dress sizes on time — a situation I clearly explained multiple times. Despite the large number of return items and the huge amount involved, the support team showed zero empathy, zero flexibility, and zero willingness to listen. They behave as if customers don’t matter once payment is done. Messages go unanswered, explanations are ignored, and they hide behind rigid policies instead of handling genuine situations responsibly. This platform is NOT customer-friendly at all. It feels like they are trained to deflect responsibility rather than solve problems. I am now stuck with expensive items that I cannot use, entirely due to their misleading information and lack of support. Even basic retail services in the UK are far more professional, ethical, and customer-oriented than this app. This experience has been nothing short of mental harassment and financial stress. I strongly warn others: DO NOT BUY from this website/app. If something goes wrong, you will be left alone with no help, no response, and no accountability. I will be formally filing complaints on the app, payment provider, and consumer protection platforms, as this level of service is unacceptable.

❌ SELLER SCAMMERS RISING IN MYNTRA PLEASE DONT ORDER MAKEUP PRODUCTS ❌. I ordered around 15k worth products from MYNTRA last week. Among them 4 products were makeup items. One item was Revolution London’s 2 makeup palette sold as one combo for Rs 2150 (offer price Rs 817). You know what - only one palette from the combo came and it was a hassle to get the refund and return despite me attaching images confirming that the package was unopened! The remaining two products was scamming level pro max! I ordered Sugar All set to go loose translucent powder & Lakme black and gold toned makeup brush AND THEY BOTH NEVER CAME. The MYNTRA website updated its status as delivered two weeks later and I was still waiting for my order! I saw the updated status and reached out to customer care in the middle of the night and you know what they said - SORRY YOUR DELIVERY WINDOW IS CLOSED! I said I wasn’t updated that the delivery was made and they still refused to refund or do anything about these both orders that cost me 2k. The whole site is filled with scammers now! Please don’t order any makeup items from MYNTRA! I used this platform for over 10 years and this experience was disgusting! And MYNTRA’s review policy didn’t even let me post the picture of the poor condition of the delivered makeup palette and they deleted my picture and review! Low blow MYNTRA! Low blow! I am filing a case in consumer court as of today because my home is camera monitored so I could easily procure the CCTV footages from the alleged date of delivery MYNTRA said the products were delivered. Thankfully God is on my side in this case! Hope you suffer in hell Seller scammers in MYNTRA! It’s pathetic to see how down MYNTRA has fallen!👎🏻
